title.narrative: Quantum Science, Emerging Technologies and STEM Capacity Development

description.narrative:
Quantum science and technology are rapidly emerging as transformative fields with the potential to revolutionize computing, communications, sensing, materials science, healthcare, energy systems and scientific discovery. However, significant disparities in access to infrastructure, expertise, investment and educational opportunities risk creating a global quantum divide, limiting the ability of many countries to participate in and benefit from these advances.
Through this work plan, UNESCO will support Member States in building the capacities, partnerships and enabling environments required to participate in the quantum era. Activities will focus on strengthening quantum education and skills development, promoting international scientific cooperation, advancing equitable access to knowledge and infrastructure, fostering responsible innovation and governance, and supporting the development of national and regional quantum ecosystems. Particular attention will be given to developing countries, Africa, Small Island Developing States (SIDS), and underrepresented groups, while strengthening STEM education pathways needed to prepare future generations for emerging technologies.
